books.title: Shiatsu & the Art of Conscious Cooking
books.author: Joanne Faulkner
books.description: A self-published seasonal cookbook that pairs recipes with meditations and acupressure points. It uses the Five Elements of Traditional Chinese Medicine to link mood, cravings and food choices through the year.

books.title: Good Food: Better Sex
books.author: Joanne Faulkner
books.description: A cookbook and guide to intimacy drawing on Traditional Chinese Medicine, with around 100 recipes. It combines food, acupressure and Five Element ideas about sexual energy and connection between partners.

courses.title: Chi Flow with Jo
courses.description: Live online qigong every weekday morning at 8.30am Dublin time, with an optional silent meditation beforehand and a live Q&A afterwards. Members get the daily recording by email with acupressure and food tips, a monthly evening talk, a monthly loving-kindness meditation and a library of over 100 videos.

courses.title: Qi Gong & Five Element Retreat Holiday, Agistri, Greece
courses.description: A seven-night residential retreat on the Greek island of Agistri, mainly for women. Days include sunrise qigong, Five Element teaching, Shiatsu, meditation, healing sounds and journaling, with breakfast, dinner and a day trip to Aegina included.

free_resources.title: Free Monthly Qi Gong Class
free_resources.description: A free live online Chi Flow qigong class on the last weekday of each month, open to beginners. You sign up with your email to get the link, and the recording is emailed afterwards.

free_resources.title: Chi Flow with Jo Podcast (Ask Me Anything and Energy Update)
free_resources.description: Joanne's free podcast, also filmed for YouTube, with two strands: Ask Me Anything episodes answering listeners' questions, and Energy Update episodes with seasonal qigong, acupressure and food guidance. It is available on Spotify and Apple Podcasts too.
